caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers, composed of a vertical rectangular structure with five horizontal drawers. Four of the drawers are closed, each featuring a single round metal handle in the center. The second drawer from the bottom is open and acts as a pull-out writing surface supported by metal arms attached at each side, colored gold, with a flat black inlay on the writing surface. Inside the open drawer, several small vertical dividers and compartments are visible, designed for organizing papers or writing instruments. The wood is depicted in a warm, medium brown tone with visible grain, and the background is a neutral, light beige color. The edges of the chest are clearly delineated, and the feet are short and slightly curved.
title: Shaker Secretary
